title: 第11章 冒险第12章 这种帕瓦我一定要得到
lines: 格林终究还是没有如愿摸到古兹的翅膀，虽然他可以在古兹睡着的时候摸，但是那样没有什么兴致。
格林主要就是想看看古兹的反应，古兹睡着后怎么摸都没有反应。
当然，格林是有分寸的，在古兹允许前，格林是不会去动隐私部位的，不会主动去动。
时间来到了晚上，在检查了雇佣工的工作后，格林又处理了一些文件：内容主要是些和甜品有关的商业合作，对象是帝国商会等。
合作内容在格林看来不怎么合理，也是，谁让人家是皇室贵族呢？不过，也不是非他不可。
帝国的经济主要由三个商会控制，背靠皇室的帝国商会，资金最多；分布最广的冒险商会，首领是一位半神级冒险者；以及存在最久的伊莎贝拉公会，是由伊莎贝拉家族控制的，他们在赫卡鲁斯时期创立。
格林拿起了冒险商会的文件，看了眼条例，冒险商会的合作内容倒是合理。
但是他们要求格林以后的产品也要与他们合作，开玩笑，全给你们了我怎么坐地起价（不是），怎么合理根据市场情况调整价格。
格林放下了文件，看向了桌上最后的“文件”
伊莎贝拉商会送来的不是文件，而是一份邀请函，他们邀请格林参加一场晚宴，顺便谈谈商业合作。
有点意思，不过好在三个商会给了他充足时间来考虑，短时间内都不需要担心。
将文件和邀请函收好，格林前往了森林，开始了每日的刷怪任务。
如果他有系统，或许可以搞点东西、加点什么的。
可惜他没有。
不过有系统也不一定有他方便，死后复活加刷新状态什么的，强度很高了。
更别说还有黑烟这个能力，格林发现黑烟可以加强自己，加强的内容跟黑烟的物种有关。
而且黑烟还可以让自己不断解析那个物种，随着黑烟的吸收，格林估计可以完全解析一个物种。
干脆利落地撕开血藤精，掏出它的魔核，感受着所谓的魔力——玛纳，格林觉得十分有趣。
魔法，依靠魔力通过特定行径对现实世界造成影响的活动，魔力可被观察、真实存在，并且还可以与物质和能量发生相互作用。
而生命对于魔力的应用会因为相互作用在血脉里留下印记——魔纹或者说魔法回路，而历史越久远的家族，其流传的魔纹越强大。
这也是“血统论”
的根源，即越古老的家族越高贵，这是古老的家族里，其拥有的魔纹越强。
这对于其他种族也是一样的，那些原始流传下来的种族一般比其他新生种族高贵。
当然，也有例外。
魔纹也有可能变异，可能发生良性变异，也有可能发生恶性变异，还可能无性（不是）。
而一个关于物种的知识自然包括该物种的魔纹，所以……
格林吸收了一下魔核里的魔力，伴随着意念运作，一道道木地刺冲出地面。
“可惜我没有多少魔力啊。”
和其他方面相比，格林的魔力简直少的可怜，估计在没有外界魔力的加成下，一根地刺估计都释放不出来。
格林试着通过其他方式增加魔力上限，但市面上有的东西全都没有效果。
连微弱提升都做不到，比如10金币一个的魔力奇果。
按照古兹吃后的描述，魔力量确实提升了，但是第二颗的效果就减半了，然后以此类推。
content_en:
After all, Green still couldn't touch Guzi's wings as he wished. Although he could touch Guzi when he was asleep, it would be uninteresting.
Green mainly wanted to see Guz's reaction. Guz had no reaction no matter how much he touched him after falling asleep.
Of course, Green is measured. Before Guz gives permission, Green will not touch his private parts, nor will he take the initiative to do so.
At night, after checking the work of the hired workers, Green processed some documents: the content was mainly about business cooperation related to desserts, with the Imperial Chamber of Commerce and others.
The content of the cooperation is not very reasonable in Green's view. Also, who wants someone to be a royal noble? However, it doesn't have to be him.
The economy of the empire is mainly controlled by three chambers of commerce. The Imperial Chamber of Commerce, which is backed by the royal family, has the most funds; the most widely distributed Adventure Chamber of Commerce, whose leader is a demigod-level adventurer; and the longest-standing Isabella Guild, which is controlled by the Isabella family and was founded during the Herkarus period.
Green picked up the documents from the Adventure Chamber of Commerce and looked at the regulations. The cooperation content of the Adventure Chamber of Commerce was reasonable.
But they asked Green to cooperate with them on future products. Just kidding, it’s all up to you how to raise the price (no) and how to reasonably adjust the price according to market conditions.
Green put down the file and looked at the last "file" on the table.
What the Isabella Chamber of Commerce sent was not a document, but an invitation letter. They invited Green to a dinner to discuss business cooperation.
It's a bit interesting, but fortunately the three chambers of commerce gave him enough time to think about it, so there is no need to worry in the short term.
After putting away the documents and invitations, Green went to the forest and began his daily task of spawning monsters.
If he had a system, he might be able to get something done, add something or something.
Too bad he didn't.
However, having a system is not necessarily convenient for him. Resurrection after death and refreshing status are very powerful.
Not to mention the ability of Black Smoke. Green discovered that Black Smoke can strengthen himself, and the enhancement content is related to the species of Black Smoke.
Moreover, the black smoke can also allow him to continuously analyze that species. As the black smoke is absorbed, Green estimates that he can completely analyze a species.
Green found it very interesting to simply tear open the blood vine spirit, take out its magic core, and feel the so-called magic power - Mana.
Magic is an activity that relies on magic to affect the real world through specific actions. Magic can be observed, real, and can also interact with matter and energy.
The application of magic power in life will leave a mark in the bloodline due to the interaction - magic patterns or magic circuits. The longer the history of the family, the more powerful the magic patterns passed down by it.
This is also the "blood theory"
The root of this is that the older the family, the more noble it is. This is the reason why the older family has stronger magic patterns.
This is the same for other races. Those races that have been originally handed down are generally nobler than other new races.
Of course, there are exceptions.
Magic patterns may also mutate, either benignly or malignantly, or asexual (not).
And knowledge about a species naturally includes the magic pattern of that species, so...
Green absorbed the magic power in the magic core, and with the operation of his mind, wooden spikes rushed out of the ground.
"It's a pity that I don't have much magic power."
Compared with other aspects, Green's magic power is pitifully small. It is estimated that without the addition of external magic power, not even a single thorn can be released.
Green tried to increase the magic limit through other methods, but nothing on the market was effective.
It can't even achieve a weak improvement, such as a magic fruit with 10 gold coins each.
According to Guzi's description after eating it, the magic power was indeed increased, but the effect of the second pill was halved, and so on.
